Commentary.Commentary: So, the hosts will in the end be pleased with how they could close out their batting. Now it is upto their bowlers, who, also batted well earlier, to repeat their feats, with the ball this time! With a spinner less this time and taking a cue from how Zampa had bowled earlier, it will be interesting to see how England go about. Stay tuned for the chase.

Australia, who were largely indubitably at their best, with the ball, withered towards the end. The pace duo of Starc and Hazlewood was exceptional at the start. Following on their success was Zampa, who delivered the breakthrough in his very first over, getting the English Test skipper, Joe Root. He then went after the limited overs captain, Morgan, and snared him shortly as well. The Aussies had a field time till they got 8 English wickets. After that though, they allowed the momentum to slip away as Rashid and Tom Curran started playing some good shots and posted a respectable score in the end for the visitors to chase.

Earlier, England had won the toss and Morgan opted to bat first. Bairstow fell early while Roy was looking in good touch. However, to the latter's bad luck, he was run out, after a confusion with Root. Morgan walked in next and Root and the English limited overs captain batted their hearts out to stave off the looming challenge. Root, though, looked to be in Test match mode, gobbling up the deliveries while doing little to up his scoring. Eventually, both he and Morgan fell in quick span and so did Buttler. Sam Billings failed to make a mark this time as was Sam Curran and England were tottering. Woakes played well but could not last long too. And just when it looked all done and dusted for the Three Lions, Rashid and Tom Curran resuscitated them well. Those two were crucial in helping England go past 230.

Right then, the English tail has batted commendably and taken the hosts to a very respectable total! In fact, they are now going to bowl and defend what they have helped England get to, we can say! When Woakes got out, England were 149/8, entering the 41st over. At that moment, nobody would have guessed what Rashid and Tom Curran had in mind, as to how they would go about. Well, atleast not the Aussies! In the end, they ended up allowing a free flow of runs to the two and the pair also milked valuable runs to help England put up a good total in the end.
FOUR! Great end to the innings! England end in a flourish! Short ball on middle, Archer pulls it over the bowler's head for a boundary. ENGLAND FINISH ON 231 FOR 9.
Good length ball outside off, Archer punches it to long off and picks up a couple.
Jofra Archer is the last man in.

OUT! TIMBER! Finally, Australia break this stand! End of a brilliant partnership as these two have brought England back into this game! Curran walks back! Good length ball on middle, Curran targets the mid-wicket boundary and looks to swing it that way but misses. The ball goes onto hit the stumps. Marsh just walks back to his mark.
Short on middle, Curran splices it towards long on. Rashid wants the couple and takes off. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Curran back on strike.
Good length ball on off, Curran heaves it to deep mid-wicket and picks up a couple before the fielder cuts it off.
WIDE! Slower short ball around middle, Curran looks to hook but misses. Wide given.
FOUR! Hammered! Two fielders in the deep but finds the gap to perfection! Short ball on the pads, Curran pulls it to deep square leg for a boundary.
Mitchell Marsh will bowl the final over.
Short ball outside off, Curran punches it to deep cover for a single. 18 from the over.
Three runs now! Full ball outside off, Rashid slices it to deep point. Stoinis comes across and cleans it up. Three taken. The umpires check whether it is a clean save and it is.
FOUR! Another boundary! 14 already from the over! Short on middle, Rashid pulls it to deep square leg for another boundary.
SIX! What a shot that is! This has been some partnership! Shortish on middle, Rashid whacks it over the deep square leg region for a maximum.
Short ball on middle, Rashid looks to pull but misses.

FOUR! Nice way to bring up the 50-run stand between Curran and Rashid! Important partnership as it has taken England to a respectable score! Fullish ball outside off, Rashid smears it to the deep point region for a boundary.
Length ball again, Rashid taps this on the off side and gets to the other end. He will keep strike in the next over.
Rashid shuffles across but adjusts himself late in the end and guides this length ball to third man for a couple.
A single as this full length delivery is nudged to wide mid off and the batters exchange ends.
WIDE! Fires a length delivery down the leg side, Tom looked to work that away to fine leg but misses. Carey stops that and a wide is called by the umpire.
Full length ball on the leg pole, Adil clips this to wide mid on and takes one.
This time he pushes this length delivery past point and takes a single.
FOUR! Useful runs from the bat of Tom Curran! Starc bowls this full and in the blockhole outside off, Curran puts bat on ball and gets it away to the third man region for a boundary.
Short on middle, Rashid looks to pull but fails to get any bat on it.
WIDE! Short ball on middle, Adil ducks under it. Wide given.

Length ball outside off, Rashid pushes it to deep cover and takes off for a single. Curran wants the second but Rashid sends him back. Stoinis hits a direct throw at the keeper's end and the ball rolls to fine leg, allowing the batters to take another run.
Short ball around middle and leg, Rashid looks to pull but misses.
FOUR! Powered! Excellent batting from Rashid! Good length ball on middle, Rashid powers it to the long on region for a boundary.
Slower ball outside off, Curran looks to cut but it takes the outside edge and goes towards short third man. A single taken.
Full on middle, Rashid plays it to fine leg for a single.
Full ball on the pads, Rashid flicks it to deep mid-wicket and will keep strike for the next over with a single.
Good length ball outside off, Tom drives it to deep cover for a single.
SWING AND A MISS! Fullish ball outside off, Curran looks to drive it but the ball beats the outside edge and goes into the mitts of the keeper.
Curran misses out! Low full toss outside off, Curran looks to drive but misses it.
Slower short ball outside off, Curran sways away from it. Good comeback from Starc.
FOUR! Curran is adding some valuable runs here for England! Full outside off, Curran hammers it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Mitchell Starc is back on. 8-1-21-1 are his figures so far.
BEATEN! Fullish length ball outside off, Adil Rashid looks to drive on the up but fails to get bat on ball.

Cummins appeals mildly for LBW but height was always going to be an issue there! Length delivery on middle and leg, Rashid looked to play at it but misses. He gets hit on the top of his pads and the ball rolls over to the off side. The umpire says no to Cummins' appeal. A dot.
WIDE! Cummins bowls a bouncer which was way too high, wided by the umpire.
Length ball outside off, Tom guides this to third man for one.
FOUR! Good shot, good strong shot from Tom Curran, down the ground! Full length delivery on off, he lofts this uppishly and over the bowler's head, to long off and collects a boundary.
On middle, Rashid works this to behind square on the leg side for a single.
On the pads, Curran works this down the leg side for one.
Pat Cummins is back into the attack. He has bowled 7 overs, conceded 21 and picked up a wicket in the process as well.
Tossed up on off, Rashid defends it out. Zampa finishes with figures of 10-0-36-3. Brilliant stuff.
On middle, Curran moves down the track and flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Looped up on middle, Rashid pushes it to long on for another single.
Floated outside off, Curran drives it to long off for a single.
Flatter on the pads, Curran nudges it to square leg.
Full on the pads, Adil pushes it to long on for a single.
Slower one outside off, Curran looks to flick but misses it completely.
Full ball on middle, Rashid looks to defend but it goes off the inside edge towards the deep on the leg side. Only a single.
Back of a length ball on middle, Tom tucks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short ball outside off, Curran cuts it to deep point and picks up a couple before Stoinis cuts it off.
FOUR! Valuable runs for England! Full ball on middle and leg, Curran dances down the track and heaves it to the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Full ball on off, Curran pushes it to cover.
Mitchell Marsh is back into the attack. He has bowled 6 overs for 26 and is yet to get a wicket.
Quicker one on off, Rashid rocks back and defends it out.
Fuller on the pads, Rashid looks to defend but gets hit on the pads.
Flatter on middle, Rashid blocks it out onto the pitch.
Tossed up outside off, Curran drives it to deep cover and crosses over for a single.
Loopy ball on middle, Curran flicks it to mid on for another dot.
Short ball on middle, Rashid pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Adam Zampa is back in the attack. 8-0-30-3 are his figures.
Full ball on off, Curran blocks it to the off side. End of an excellent spell from Hazlewood. He finishes with 10-2-27-1.
Back of a length on off, Curran dances down the track and defends it to point.
Full on off, Curran defends it to cover.
On a length on the pads, Curran looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Good length ball on middle, Rashid flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Who will walk out next? Adil Rashid it is.

OUT! CAUGHT! Brilliant line and length from Hazlewood! He was excellent in the first game and has continued his form in this game as well. England stuttering big time in this game! They need something special to get to a respectable score on the board. Hazlewood bowls a good length ball outside off, Woakes looks to drive but does not move his feet. It takes the outside edge and goes to Carey who makes no mistake. Australia celebrate and rightly so.
Powerplay 3 has been signalled! Now a maximum of 5 fielders can be stationed outside the 30-yard circle till the end of the innings.
Full on middle, almost yorker length, Curran digs it out for a dot.
On off, Tom Curran keeps this out.
Full length delivery on the leg pole, Curran wanted to turn that down the leg side but closes the face too early. It is played back to the bowler.
Fullish ball on middle, Woakes flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! That will do, just a hint of width and Woakes latches on to that! Back of a length delivery outside off, Woakes hits this over covers for a boundary.
Length and on the off stump, Woakes defends it out.
Good length ball on off, Curran pushes it to mid off.
Good length ball on middle, Tom works it to square leg.
Very full delivery on middle, Curran flicks it to mid-wicket.
On a length on off, Curran blocks it to point.
Length ball on middle, Tom defends it to mid on.
Inside edge saves Woakes! Good length ball on off, Woakes looks to defend but it takes the inside edge, hits the pads and goes to the off side. A single taken.
Tom Curran comes out to bat, replacing his brother Sam. Hazlewood is back on.

OUT! CAUGHT! Right then, after much deliberation, that has been given out! Umpire Gough referred it upstairs and the third umpire has a close, careful look and rules that out in the end. Starc bowls this on a length outside off, Sam looked to defend that even though it was well away from his body. He though gets an outside edge which goes low to Carey. The keeper takes it and he and Starc appeal. Umpire Gough wanted to check if Carey had collected that properly and hence takes it to the third umpire. And the third umpire, after having a look at it to his satisfaction, deems that Carey got his gloves under the ball and took it safely. England lose their seventh and Morgan's decision to bat first seems to be backfiring badly here!
Has that carried? The umpires get together and signal for the third umpire. The soft signal is out. Sam Curran is the man in question. Carey's gloves are under the ball and Curran has to go.
Starc searching for the yorker. Bowls a very low full toss outside off, Woakes drives it to deep extra cover for one.
Starc rushes in and bowls a full length delivery from wide of the crease, squares Woakes up as he looked to turn that to the leg side.
Drives the fuller one but picks out the man at cover who dives and contains it. A dot.
Full and on middle, Woakes just about keeps it out to the off side.
Fuller on off, Woakes looks to drive but the ball comes off the inner half of his blade. It goes to mid on.
Rocks back and works this flatter ball to the on side for a dot.
On the shorter side again, outside off, Sam defends it back on to the pitch.
Flatter ball outside off, Sam Curran guides this to the man at point.
Floats this on off, Woakes drives this to long off and gets to the other end.
Curran cuts the flatter ball past point for one. He is off the mark.
Sam Curran is the next out in the middle.

OUT! BOWLED! Just got done by the length more than anything else! And it is that man again, Adam Zampa! Billings gives himself room and looked to work this flatter ball on the off side. He though ends up getting a bottom edge and the ball rolls behind and clips the bail. Billings, who was dangerous last match, departs now and Australia are all over the hosts here!
Starc steams in and bowls a fuller length ball on middle and leg, Sam drives that to mid on and gets to the other end.
On a length on the off stump line, worked to the man at deep point for a single.
Uppish but safe, and a couple! Full length delivery on middle from around the crease. Woakes lifts this uppishly towards deep square leg and bags a couple.
Length delivery again, on the off stump, Woakes keeps it out to short cover.
Length on off and middle, a quick single as Billings taps this to cover-point and gets to the other end.
Full on the off pole, stroked to mid off for a dot.
Mitchell Starc is back into the attack. 5-1-10-1 are his figures so far.
BEATEN! Excellent flight there from Zampa! Looped up outside off, Woakes prods forward to block but does not read the flight, ends up missing the same.
Adam floats this on the stumps, Woakes taps this to mid-wicket for a dot.
On middle, Sam sweeps this towards square leg for one.
Floats this full and in the blockhole on off, Woakes digs it out to long off for a single.
Loopy ball on middle, worked back to the bowler.
FOUR! That is brilliant from Woakes, mid on was up and he gets it well to the right of the man there! Floated on leg, Woakes flicks this well, past mid on, and gets a boundary.
A single as Woakes pulls this on the leg side but the sweeper cuts it off.
Full on off, Woakes looks to drive but the ball comes off his inner half. It goes to mid on.
On middle, Sam works this to deep square leg and crosses over for a single.
Hazlewood bowls it short but it does not bounce as much. Sam looks to pull but as the ball does not bounce as much, he misses. It gets the top of his pads and falls on the leg side.
Good length again, around off. Billings defends it back on to the ground.
Good length ball around off, Billings strides forward and keeps it out to the off side.
Full and outside off, Woakes drives it to mid off for a dot.
Flatter on off, Woakes taps it to point.
FOUR! Poor delivery from Zampa and it has been put away! That will release some pressure! Full toss on middle, Woakes drives it past the bowler and into the fence.
Loopy ball on the pads, Woakes pushes it to mid on.
Googly on off, Woakes rocks on his back foot and defends it out.
Floated on off, Billings pushes it to long off for a single.
Uppish but safe! Good length ball on middle, Woakes drives it uppishly but it lands short of the fielder at mid on.
Full ball on off, Chris defends it to cover.
FOUR! CREAMED! Brilliant batting from Woakes! Good length ball outside off, Woakes drives it through the cover region for a boundary.
Good stop! Good length ball on the pads, Woakes flicks it to mid-wicket where the fielder dives to make a good stop.
BEATEN! Good length ball outside off, Woakes looks to defend but gets beaten. Brilliant bowling from Hazlewood.
Full ball on off, Woakes pushes it to mid off.
Josh Hazlewood is back on. 6-2-19-0, his figures so far.
Flights this full and on off, Woakes drives this though covers and gets to the other end.
Woakes gets behind the line of the delivery and defends this out.
Flighted full on middle, Woakes works it on the leg side.

A huge appeal for LBW but not out says the umpire. Will Australia review? No, as Carey says inside edge to his captain. Floated ball on middle and leg, Woakes looked to play at it and just about gets an inside edge as he looked to work that on the leg side. An inside edge on to his boots. Australia appeal thinking it hit the pads but Carey later on says to his skipper that there was an inside edge and dissuades against the review.
Flighted outside off, Woakes drives it on the off side for a dot.
Tossed up full on off, Woakes blocks it to short mid-wicket.
Nice shot for nothing! Full ball on middle, Billings drives but straight to mid on.
Back of a length ball on off, Billings plays it to point for another dot.
On a length on off, Billings blocks it to cover.
That kept a little low! Good length ball on off, Billings manages to get his bat down in time and defends it.
Full ball on middle, Sam blocks it out onto the pitch.
Back of a length ball on middle, Billings defends it back to the bowler.
Tossed up full on middle, Woakes blocks.
Chris Woakes is the next man in.

OUT! LBW! It looked plumb in plain sight, not sure why the umpire refused that one. Australia are sure on that, take the review and get it reversed in their favour! Zampa tosses this on middle, it does not turn and goes straight and hits Morgan's pads as he strode forward to block that. Australia appeal but the umpire is unmoved. It was a no-brainer, Australia decide to review that. The Ultra Edge states that there was no bat involved there! What does the Ball Tracker say? THREE REDS! And on expected lines! Morgan has to walk back and this is excellent bowling from Zampa.
Adam floats this full on the stumps, Billings gets down and sweeps this to deep square leg for a single.
Tossed up on the stumps, Billings blocks it with a forward stride.

NOT OUT! Some confusion but Sam makes it back to the striker's end safely! Floats this full on middle, Billings comes down the track and works this to mid on. He wants to take a run there but Morgan sends him back. Some drama at the end as Billings' bat was stuck but luckily he plants hit foot well in as the throw came to the keeper.
An appeal for run out! It has been taken upstairs. Let's see what happens.
Drifting into the pads, Sam works this to short fine leg.
On middle, Morgan clips that to mid on for a dot.
Short length delivery, Billings pulls to deep square leg for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Billings looked to guide that to third man but fails to connect.
A single to follow the boundary as Morgan firmly pulls this short ball to deep square leg for one.

FOUR! Morgan has been looking really good for the last couple of overs or so. Full length ball on middle, he drives this straight past the bowler. The ball races away to the long off fence and Morgan gets a boundary.
On middle, Morgan tucks this to short mid-wicket for a dot.
Floated full on off, Billings prods forward and blocks.
Flights this on the stumps, Morgan gets down and works this behind square on the leg side for one.
A dot as Morgan pushes this floated delivery back to Zampa.
Flighted on off, Billings pushes it to mid off and takes a quick run.
Flatter ball on middle, Billings closes the face of the bat early and this comes back to Zampa as the batsman intended to turn it down to the leg side.
Tosses this around off, Morgan leans forward and pushes it towards backward point for a single.
Full delivery on middle, Sam drives it to mid on for another dot.
On off, Billings taps it to point.
Good length ball on middle, Billings works it to mid-wicket.
Sam Billings walks out at No.6 for England.

OUT! LBW! Umpire's call it is and Buttler has to go. Excellent change from Australia! Brings back Cummins into the attack and he strikes immediately. Buttler fails again in this ODI series. Good length ball on middle, Buttler looks to drive but misses and gets rapped on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW and the umpire obliges as he raises the finger. Buttler consults Morgan for the review and takes it. The Ultra Edge shows no bat while the Ball Tracker shows that it is umpire's call. Review retained.
Buttler has been given out LBW! It looks close. There is no bat but the Ball Tracker shows that it is umpire's call. Buttler has to go.
On a length on off, Buttler shuffles across and then flicks it to mid-wicket.
BEATEN! Nicely bowled! Good length ball outside off, Buttler looks to defend but fails to get any bat on it.
Good comeback from Zampa, 3 dots to finish. Morgan works this flatter ball on the off side for a dot.
Adam loops this on middle, Morgan works it back to him.
A dot as Morgan taps this looped up ball towards backward point.
FOUR! Shouts of catch but it was well over and goes to the boundary. Tossed up outside off, Morgan lofts this over covers and gets a boundary.
FOUR! Gets it fine, does Morgan! Looped up on off, Morgan goes down and reverse sweeps this to fine leg for a boundary.
Adam floats this full, almost in the blockhole on off, Morgan drives but finds mid off.
A single as he works this through the carpet past covers for one.
FOUR! Excellent shot from Morgan! Full ball outside off, Morgan goes over covers and bags a boundary.
Buttler gets to the non-striker's end by working this length ball to fine leg for one.
A single as he pulls this short length ball to square leg and crosses over for a single.
Full length delivery outside off, Morgan drives but straight to the man at cover.
On a length on top of the stumps, Buttler glances that to square leg and gets to the other end.
A dot as Morgan goes back and plays this flatter delivery to the leg side.
Buttler is off the mark. Slower through the air on the stumps, he works this towards square leg for one.
Slower in the air on middle, Buttler drives but finds Marsh at mid on.
Jos Buttler makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Good take, really good take from Aaron Finch at slip! Joe Root's struggles come to an end then! Floats this around off, the legspinner, Root looks to drive but ends up getting a thick outside edge, on account of the spin. It goes low and quick to the right of Finch at slip, who alertly pouches on to that. And Zampa, the change, has worked immediately for Australia.
Loopy ball on off, Root sweeps this to deep square leg for a couple.
Zampa starts off with a floated delivery on middle, Eoin taps this to square leg and gets a single.
Finally, Adam Zampa is coming into the attack. Can he continue his good form from the first ODI?
A hint of away swing there! Full and swinging away, outside off. Root watches carefully and guides that to point. A dot to end.
On a good length on the pads, Morgan flicks that away to fine leg for a single.
Full length ball on off, almost in the blockhole, Root digs that out to the leg side. Just the single.
On middle, Root flicks but finds short mid-wicket.
Morgan advances like Root and goes inside out over covers. He though does not get the timing right and the ball stops short of the boundary. Three added to the total.
On a length on off, Eoin works this to point and says no to the single.

SIX! Great way to end the over! England are looking to make a move-on. Brilliant! Fullish ball on middle, Root dances down the track and heaves it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. First one of the game. This brings up the 50-run stand between the two and it is an important one for the English as they lost two quick wickets. Their job is half done and will hope to continue.
On a length on off, Root defends it to point.
FOUR! Beautifully timed from Root! Good length ball outside off Root lunges forward and drives it to cover. Cummins gives a chase but the ball wins the race.
Delicately played! Good length ball outside off, Morgan guides it to third man for a single.
Shortish on middle, Root works it to deep square leg and picks up a run.
Short ball on the pads, Morgan pulls it to fine leg for a single.
Full length delivery on the off stump, an on drive by Root but straight to mid on.
Full on middle and leg, Morgan glances this down the leg side for one.
Misfield and a single in the end! On a full length outside off, Root drives this to Warner at cover who fumbles and allows a single to be taken.
Full on off, stroked to mid off for a quick single.
WIDE! Length ball down the leg side, Morgan looks to flick but misses. Wide called.
Full on middle, defended to the off side.
Full and on the pads, Root looks to flick but misses and gets hit on his pads. The ball goes to the leg side off the deflection and a leg bye is taken.
On a length outside off, Morgan guides this towards third man and takes a double.
Morgan drives this fuller ball to mid on.

FOUR! It would have been a fantastic catch had Cummins managed to get there and hold on to it! Short length ball, Morgan pulls firmly and uppishly, it goes to the left of Cummins in the deep. Cummins tries to get to the ball and puts in a dive but the ball goes past him to the deep backward square leg fence for four runs.
Length delivery outside off, Eoin blocks it out towards short cover.
Full on off, Root drives that to Starc at mid on, who has to run around to gather that. A single is taken.
Shortish length delivery on the pads, does not bounce as much as Root would have expected. He looks to pull but misses and gets it on the top of his pads.
Marcus Stoinis is into the attack.
A single as this length delivery is tapped towards third man for one.
Good fielding from Stoinis at mid-wicket. Root pulled that short length delivery hard but Stoinis does well to stop that there.
Another dot as Root pushes this fuller ball to mid on.
Shortish again, Root goes back and drives again but finds cover-point yet again.
Shortish on middle, Root goes on his back foot and pushes it to cover-point.
Full on the pads, Eoin glances that to deep square leg for a single.
On off, Root blocks it to point.

Half an appeal from Cummins for a catch but nothing from Carey or the others. Root looked to pull at the short length ball down the leg side. He does not connect and Carey takes it down the leg side. Cummins lets out half an appeal but to no avail.
Short length delivery this time, Morgan pulls but does not time it well. It manages to go to fine leg and a single is taken.
Good length delivery outside off, Morgan works this towards cover-point.
Morgan cuts this length delivery but picks out the point fielder.
Shouts of catch but it was stroked safely! Full length delivery outside off, Root strokes it uppishly to backward point and takes three runs.
Another misfield, Warner it is, at short mid-wicket. Morgan flicks the fuller ball to Warner who misfields and allows a couple to be taken. 50 up for England.
Full on the stumps, a wristly flick to the on side and a single is taken.
Full length ball on the off pole, Root defends that out to the leg side.
Shortish again, Root defends by rocking back.

FOUR! The Australian fielding was exceptional overall but this one, just the one odd blemish! Shortish and outside off, Root stands tall and punches that past the diving cover-point fielder. Labuschagne was a bit dull with the dive. It goes past him and into the boundary.
Full and on the stumps, Joe works that to the on side for a dot.
Shortish to finish as Morgan defends this one.
Another bumper, this one is ducked under as well. A dot.
WIDE! Given as wide for the height on it. Bouncer, way too above for the batsman's comfort. Eoin ducks under it and the umpire calls it a wide.
Full on the middle pole, Eoin blocks it out.
Fullish outside off, guided towards third man for one.
BEATEN! Vicious drive on the up from the Test captain! It was on a length around off, Root looks to drive but misses to connect.
Fullish on middle, Root defends that out to the leg side.

DRINKS! Australia have made a brilliant start as they have given 42 runs in 14 overs and have picked up 2 wickets. They need to continue doing the good work and make it hard for the English batters to do the same. England, on the other hand, need this partnership to continue and get the scoreboard ticking.
Good length ball on off, Morgan blocks it to the point region. Another maiden. Good start from Marsh.
On a length outside off, Morgan looks to cut but it takes the edge and rolls past the stumps and towards the keeper.
Good length ball on middle, Morgan defends it back to the bowler.

An appeal for LBW turned down! Marsh bowls a short one on middle and leg, it does not bounce as much. Morgan looks to pull but gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW but the umpire turns it down. Australia do not take the review and rightly so as the Ball Tracker shows that it is pitching down the leg side.
On a length on off, Morgan taps it to point.
Good shot for nothing! Full delivery outside off, Morgan drives it crisply but finds the cover fielder.
Mitchell Marsh to bowl now.
Right then, it is a maiden as Root drives but finds cover-point.
On a length outside off, worked to backward point. 5th dot.
Fourth dot in a row as Root pushes this fuller ball but finds point.
BEATEN! That is much better from Pat Cummins! Full length ball outside off. Root looks to drive but is beaten comprehensively!
Root shuffles across but can only work this to the man at mid-wicket. A dot ball.
Fullish and on off, worked towards short cover for a dot.
Fullish and outside off, Root steers this to third man for a single. Another good over from Hazlewood.
Good drive from Root but he finds the man at mid on. Full length delivery on off, he drives this to mid on.
Another solid blocks as Root keeps out this fuller ball to short cover.
Hazlewood bowls it full on the stumps, from wide of the crease. A solid block from Root.
On off, Root works it back to the bowler.
Good length ball on off, Root defends it to point.
Full on off, this is worked on the on side and Root crosses over for a single.
FOUR! Yeah, it does seem that the change of bat seems to have gone in his favour! Full and outside off, Root plays a lovely cover drive through extra cover for a boundary.

FOUR! The new bat seems to have done the trick for Root, but it was also just wide from square leg! Short length delivery, Root pulls uppishly, just a little to the left of square leg and gets a boundary.
Joe Root seems to have broken his bat and he is asking for a change of bat.
Root flicks the fuller ball on the leg side. A dot though.
Full and almost in the blockhole, Root closes the face of his bat to work this to short mid-wicket.
Full on off, stroked to mid on for a dot.
The umpire signals for Powerplay 2! Now a maximum of four fielders can be stationed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over. Pat Cummins is also into the attack.
No run.
A terrific over from Hazlewood and a terrific finish to the same! Back of a length ball outside off, Morgan looked to play at it but fails to do so.
Fuller ball on middle, tapped to mid on for a dot.
Digs it in shorter does Hazlewood. Morgan keeps it out.
Length again, this time Root guides it to third man and runs to the other end.
Length around off, blocked.
Hazlewood steaming in, bowls a fullish one on the pads. Morgan turns it to square leg for one. They looked for two but some good fielding from Australia forces change of plans.
Width on offer again, Root does not time the cut well. Gets an inside edge which goes past his stumps safely and to the keeper.
Oooh...Swing and a miss! Good bowling from Starc. Fullish and outside off, Root is excited with the width on offer. Looks to cut but fails to connect.
Shortish this time, on the off pole, Root knocks that towards Maxwell at point.
Good length delivery outside off, Root chooses not to fiddle with that.
On the pads, flicked wide of short fine leg for a run.
BEATEN! Well bowled, good start from Starc! On a length around off, Morgan looked to have a poke at it but fails to connect.
Full delivery on middle, Root defends it to cover. Another maiden over from Hazlewood.
Good length ball outside off, Root cuts but finds Maxwell at point.
Excellent fielding! Good length ball on the pads, Root flicks it to mid-wicket where Stoinis dives and makes a terrific stop. Saved some runs there.

BEATEN! That's a beautiful delivery from Josh Hazlewood! Root is looking uncomfortable at the crease! Good length ball around off, Root looks to defend but it beats the outside edge and goes to the keeper.
Hit on the pads! Good length ball on the pads, Root looks to defend but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is a mild appeal for LBW but it is turned down.
PLAY AND A MISS! Good length ball outside off, Root looks to drive but fails to get any bat on it.
Eoin Morgan is the next man in.

OUT! RUN OUT! There was never really a run there! Excellent athleticism from Marcus Stoinis, gets to the ball, turns and flicks the throw in to the striker's end, excellent stuff! Fuller ball on the off pole, Root plays that to cover-point and looks for a quick single. It was unnecessary though. Stoinis there gets the ball and throws it at the striker's end. The third umpire was called for and it shows that Roy was miles out of the crease. Jason Roy was looking good today but has to depart now.
The umpire will have a look at that. It is an umpire review for a run out. Replays roll in and Jason Roy was nowhere near the striker's end on the run. A clear run out.
Full and outside off, Root looked to play at that with soft hands but does not read the pace on it well. He misses it altogether.
Another dot as Root drives once again but finds Warner this time, at mid off.
Good length ball on off, driven but straight to Maxwell at point.
This time it is wider outside off and Root decides to have a go at that but misses again.
BEATEN! Excellent bowling from Starc! On a length around off, Root looks to defend at it but misses completely.
WIDE! Length ball way outside off, well past the tramline. The umpire signals wide.
A dot to finish as Roy defends this back on to the track. He looked for a single but Root says no.
Roy comes down the pitch but can only work this length delivery to the cover-point fielder. It is a packed off side field.
Full and on middle, Joe looks to defend but the ball goes to the leg side off the inside edge. Another single.
Roy pulls this short length delivery straight to deep square leg. A run taken.
On off, Root comes across, shimmies down the pitch and works this towards wide mid on for one.
On the pads, Roy glances this towards square leg and takes a single.

Joe Root seems to have got hurt on the foot after getting an edge. He throws his bat away and is seen limping. The physio comes out to have a look at him. Not good signs for England. Let's hope that he is fine. He is continuing for the moment which is good news for England.
Ouch...That ought to hurt! Full length delivery on the off stump line, Root looks to drive on the off side but ends up getting an inside edge onto his boots. He looks to be in visible pain here!

FOUR OFF LEG BYES! Did that come off the bat, no leg byes, says the umpire. Back of a length ball on top of the stumps, Root looked to work that on the leg side but gets it near his ribcage. It goes off the deflection and in to the fine leg fence for a boundary off extras.
Length delivery, this time he works this to the off side for a dot.
Fuller and on off this time, Root drives but finds mid off.
Short and outside off, left alone.
Who will walk out now? Joe Root it is, at No.3.

OUT! CAUGHT! It is always difficult to play a left-armer when he bowls that sort of a delivery! There was nothing much Bairstow could do about that though! On a length just around off, in the probing channel. Bairstow hangs his bat out looking to defend. He though gets a thick outside edge which goes to Carey. The keeper does well to take a good, low catch. Australia draw first blood.
FOUR! And this time he goes on the off side again, this is an excellent start from Jason Roy! Full and well outside off, Roy cuts this well away from point for a boundary.
FOUR! Just eased that one, eased! Full and on middle and leg, Roy flicks this with ease to the deep square leg region and bags a boundary.
Length delivery around the off stump, Roy defends it back on to the pitch.
Full length delivery on middle, Roy taps this to short mid-wicket. A dot.
FOUR! Roy goes on the off side this time and the outfield is lighting quick! Full and outside off, Roy drives this past extra cover for a boundary.
Fullish on the off pole, squares up Roy as he looked to play at that. Gets the top of his thigh pad and goes to the off side.
Fuller ball, stroked to mid on for a quick single. Roy will retain strike for the next over.
Short and down the leg side, just to the right of Roy's shoulder. He though lets it through and the umpire signals to Starc that it was the second one of the over.
Another one in the channel, outside off, Roy flashes at it but misses completely.
WIDE! Short, way too short, down the leg side. Roy does not play at it. Wided.
This time it is short and outside off, Roy looks to cut again. This time, he is beaten for the bounce on that.
Length ball outside off, kept low on its way. Roy looked to cut but it goes under his flashing blade on to the keeper.
FOUR! Misfield there and just what Jason Roy wanted! Full and on off, Roy strokes this to mid on. Cummins there fails to collect the ball properly. It goes past him and into the boundary ropes.
On off, Jonny defends. A maiden over from Hazlewood.
This time, Hazlewood bowls a back of a length delivery around off, Bairstow goes for the pull but does not connect.
Length ball in the channel outside off, perfect for the cut. Bairstow looks to do so but misses.
Full length delivery on the fifth stump line, Bairstow defends that out.
Length and on top of off, defended back on to the pitch.
In the air...but safe! Short length delivery around off, Bairstow looked to pull but mistimes his shot. It though lands safely on the on side. He needs to be careful here, Bairstow.
Josh Hazlewood to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
Fullish length ball outside off, Roy works that to point for a dot.
Length and around off, blocked.
Full on off, Roy looked to drive but gets it off his inner half. It goes to mid on.
On middle, flicked to square leg for a couple. Roy is off the mark.

NOT OUT! Not good umpiring from the on-field umpire there, it was going well over the top of the stumps. Starc bowls this on a length on middle, Roy looked to play at it, misses and gets hit on the pads. Starc appeals and the umpire raises his finger. Roy has a chat with Bairstow and takes the review, almost close to the end of the timer. And he succesfully gets it reversed in his favour.

Roy takes the review! It is for a LBW decision given on-field that went against him. There is no bat involved as per the replays, so we move to Ball Tracker then. In comes Ball Tracker and it says that the ball was going over the stumps. Good review then by England!
Starc, with a length ball outside off, first up. Roy shoulders arms to that.

The players are out in the middle! The Australians make their way out and the English openers, Jason Roy and Jonny Bairstow follow. Starc with the ball for Australia. It is a great sunny day at Manchester! Umpire says play and off we are then...

Aaron Finch, Australia's captain, says that had he won the toss, he would have done the same, bat first. Finch reckons that the wicket did not do much in the last game and hence batting would have been preferred. On Starc, he says that Mitchell is a true professional and is game ready. Finch says that he is looking forward to this game as well.

Eoin Morgan, England's captain, says England will bat first because he believes the wicket is the same and that it will aid the batting. He further says that the wicket did not spin as much as expected in the last game. On the changes in the team, he says that the Curran brothers make their way into the team, in place of Mark Wood and Moeen Ali.

Australia (Unchanged Playing XI) - David Warner, Aaron Finch (C), Marcus Stoinis, Marnus Labuschagne, Mitchell Marsh, Alex Carey (WK), Glenn Maxwell, Pat Cummins, Mitchell Starc, Adam Zampa, Josh Hazlewood.

England (Playing XI) - Jason Roy, Jonny Bairstow, Joe Root, Eoin Morgan (C), Jos Buttler (WK), Sam Billings, Chris Woakes, Tom Curran (In place of Mark Wood), Sam Curran (In place of Moeen Ali), Adil Rashid, Jofra Archer.
Toss - Toss time at Manchester for the second ODI! Up goes the coin and it lands in England's favour. ENGLAND WILL BAT!

Right then, the Aussies won the first ODI and won it decently well, towards the end. To thump over the reigning world champions required serious stuff and the visitors showed plenty of the same, managing to stave off the Billings threat in the closing stages as well. With the heads up, they would want to close the series in their favour by wrapping up game two to their liking as well. They have Steven Smith back for this game, although how he would be accomodated would be interesting to see! For England, it will be to avoid a repeat of the last game. They have had a wonderful cricket summer and they would want to finish it off well. An exciting clash is about to begin! Stay with us as we bring you the toss and the teams!
